description.ko: 호스트 에이전트(C++)의 이상 행위 이벤트를 웹훅으로 수신·분석하는 행위 기반 알림 에이전트입니다. 전용 화면이 없어 좌측 메뉴에는 표시되지 않으며, AI 어시스턴트를 통해 질의응답으로 사용합니다.
description.en: Behavior-based alerting agent that receives and analyzes anomalous-behavior events from the C++ host agent via webhook. It has no dedicated screen and does not appear in the left menu — use it via Q&A through the AI Assistant.

name: Behavior Notification Receiver
description_en: Receives C++ anomalous-behavior events from host agents via webhook, stores them in an in-memory deque, and provides query, stats, and status endpoints. It has no dedicated screen and does not appear in the left menu — use it via Q&A through the AI Assistant.

endpoints.description: Receive a behavior event from C++ agent
Enabled flag, event count, last event summary

env_vars.name: BEHAVIOR_NOTI_WEBHOOK_SECRET
env_vars.description: HMAC secret; if empty, signature check is skipped

env_vars.name: BEHAVIOR_NOTI_EVENTS_MAX
env_vars.description: Maximum events held in the in-memory deque
